camel_example: aliyun sas ModifyWebLockStart --region cn-hangzhou --Uuid '80d2f7d6-31a9-4d7f-8ff4-7ecc42f89ca0000' --DefenceMode block --Mode whitelist --LocalBackupDir '/usr/local/backup' --Dir '/home/admin/tomcat'
description_en: Creates web tamper proofing protection for a specified server and enables the protection
description_zh: 为指定服务器创建网页防篡改保护并开启防护
kebab_example: aliyun sas modify-web-lock-start --biz-mode whitelist --local-backup-dir /usr/local/backup --dir /home/admin/tomcat --uuid 80d2f7d6-31a9-4d7f-8ff4-7ecc42f89ca0000 --defence-mode block --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyWebLockStart

parameters.help_en:
The protection type. Valid values:
whitelist: whitelist mode. Protects the specified protection directories and file types.
blacklist: blacklist mode. Protects all subdirectories, file types, and specified files in the protection directories that are not excluded
parameters.help_zh:
指定防护类型。取值：
whitelist：白名单模式，对添加的防护目录和文件类型进行保护。
blacklist：黑名单模式，对添加的防护目录下所有未排除的子目录、文件类型和指定文件进行保护
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The local backup path used to back up the protection directories. The format of the protection directory path may differ between Linux servers and Windows servers. Make sure that you enter the path in the correct format. The following examples show the directory formats:
Linux server: /usr/local/aegis/bak
Windows server: C:\Program Files (x86)\Alibaba\Aegis\bak
parameters.help_zh:
配置本地备份路径，用于对防护目录进行安全备份。  
Linux服务器和Windows服务器防护目录地址的格式可能会有区别，请您确保输入正确的格式。您可以参考以下目录格式：
Linux服务器：/usr/local/aegis/bak
Windows服务器：C:\Program Files (x86)\Alibaba\Aegis\bak
parameters.name: local_backup_dir

parameters.help_en:
The files that do not require web tamper proofing protection (excluded files).
This parameter is required when the Defense mode Mode is set to the blacklist pattern
parameters.help_zh:
指定无需开启网页防篡改防护的文件（即排除文件）。
防护模式Mode配置为blacklist时，您需要配置该参数
parameters.name: exclusive_file

parameters.help_en: The protection directories. Separate multiple directories with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 指定防护目录，存在多个时用英文逗号（,）分隔
